eventSteps.label: Pull current OIG Work Plan and active items
eventSteps.description: Download the current OIG Work Plan; filter to items relevant to home health.
eventSteps.instructions:
1. Download OIG Work Plan from oig.hhs.gov
2. Filter for: home health agencies, hospice, Medicare Part A claims, billing integrity
3. Tag each item: Active / Anticipated / Closed
4. Identify items added since last annual review
eventSteps.expectedOutput: Filtered OIG Work Plan extract relevant to the agency

eventSteps.label: Assess agency exposure per Work Plan item
eventSteps.description: For each relevant item, score agency exposure (high/medium/low) based on services, billing patterns, prior findings.
eventSteps.instructions:
1. For each item, document: relevance, exposure rating, current controls, gaps
2. Cross-reference internal audit history
3. Cross-reference billing/claims patterns
4. Identify controls needing strengthening
eventSteps.expectedOutput: OIG Exposure Matrix with control gaps

eventSteps.label: Annual OIG Work Plan review session
eventSteps.description: Compliance Committee reviews exposure matrix and approves audit-focus adjustments.
eventSteps.instructions:
1. Walk through OIG Work Plan extract
2. Review exposure matrix
3. Approve adjustments to internal audit and monitoring focus
4. Confirm OIG/SAM screening (CO-WF-15) and self-disclosure (CO-WF-16) protocols are operating
5. Confirm FWA training (CO-WF-08) reflects current OIG enforcement themes
eventSteps.expectedOutput: Approved OIG Alignment Plan for next 12 months

eventSteps.label: Communicate adjusted audit focus and update training
eventSteps.description: Distribute alignment plan; update FWA training content to reflect new OIG enforcement themes.
eventSteps.instructions:
1. Distribute alignment plan to Internal Audit, Billing, Clinical leadership
2. Update CO-WF-08 FWA training content
3. Confirm next-year work plan (CO-FM-011) reflects OIG focus
eventSteps.expectedOutput: Updated CO-FM-011 work plan + refreshed FWA training content

workflows.title: PLAN OF CARE AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Signed Plan of Care Audit Report (CO-FM-024) with defect rate, episode-level findings, CAPs issued, and trend chart vs. prior 3 audits. Filed to /audit/<YYYY>/CL/CL-WF-26/.
workflows.sla: Monthly cycle completes within 7 business days of trigger. Findings must reach QA-WF-03 packet ≥5 business days before quarterly meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Defect rate >10% or any unsigned POC > 30 days → immediate escalation to Compliance Officer; CAP routed via CO-WF-04. Repeat failure of same clinician across 2 consecutive cycles → HR-WF-09 disciplinary path. Findings always feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Append-only audit log per cycle: sampling frame size, sample IDs, scoring sheets, defect register, CAP register, sign-off. Sample evidence retained ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-06, CL-WF-18, CO-WF-04, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: OASIS ACCURACY AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Per-clinician OASIS Accuracy Scorecard, aggregate defect register, HHRG impact analysis, remediation queue for CL-WF-25.
workflows.sla: Cycle completes within 7 business days. Corrected OASIS resubmissions filed within 30 days of detection per CMS.
workflows.escalationLogic: Per-clinician error rate >7% → mandatory CL-WF-25 competency revalidation. Any pattern of upcoding → CO-WF-08 (FWA) investigation. Material HHRG impact → FN-WF-15 RCM self-audit.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: sampling frame size, sample IDs, per-clinician scoring, defect register, HHRG impact, CAP register. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-05, CL-WF-25, FN-WF-15, QA-WF-03. Retention ≥6 years.

workflows.title: VISIT DOCUMENTATION AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Visit Documentation Audit Report with timeliness/skilled-need/alignment scores, per-clinician scorecard, CAP register.
workflows.sla: Monthly cycle completes within 7 business days. CAPs assigned within 5 business days of finding.
workflows.escalationLogic: Late-filing rate >5% → systemic CAP via CO-WF-14. Repeat clinician failure → HR-WF-09 + CL-WF-25. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: sampling frame, per-discipline scoring, CAP register. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-09, CL-WF-10, CL-WF-21, CO-WF-14, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: CLINICAL RECORD COMPLETENESS AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Record Completeness Report; per-record defect register; CAP register; trend vs prior quarter.
workflows.sla: Quarterly cycle completes within 10 business days; before QA-WF-03 packet deadline.
workflows.escalationLogic: Defect rate >5% → CO-WF-14 systemic CAP. Missing record elements that block billing → FN-WF-15. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: frame, sample IDs, scoring, CAP register. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-01, CL-WF-04, CL-WF-19, CL-WF-21, CO-WF-14, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: SKILLED NEED / MEDICAL NECESSITY REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Skilled Need Audit Report; episode-level disposition (justified / hold / discharge); billing exception queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Holds applied within 24h of detection.
workflows.escalationLogic: Pattern of insufficient skilled-need documentation → CO-WF-08 FWA review. Material findings → FN-WF-15. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: frame, sample IDs, dispositions, hold/discharge log. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-02, CL-WF-09, FN-WF-04, FN-WF-15, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: MEDICATION MANAGEMENT AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Medication Management Audit Report; reconciliation/double-check/education scorecards; CAP register; RCA queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. RCA initiated within 24h of detected medication error.
workflows.escalationLogic: Any medication error → QA-WF-05 RCA. Pattern → policy update via EN-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: frame, sample IDs, reconciliation/double-check status, error log, RCA links. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-12, RM-WF-13, QA-WF-05, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: INFECTION CONTROL COMPLIANCE AUDIT
workflows.outputs: IC Compliance Audit Report; observation scorecard; surveillance reconciliation; cluster log.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Cluster RCA initiated within 24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: HAI cluster → QA-WF-05 + RM-WF-06 surge readiness check. PPE compliance <95% → systemic CAP via HR-WF-07 retraining. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: observation roster, scoring, surveillance reconciliation, cluster log, CAPs. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-14, QA-WF-06, QA-WF-05, RM-WF-06, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: CARE COORDINATION AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Care Coordination Audit Report; episode-level scorecard; CAP register.
workflows.sla: Quarterly cycle ≤7 business days; before QA-WF-03 packet deadline.
workflows.escalationLogic: Coordination gap pattern → policy update via EN-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: frame, sample IDs, scorecards, CAPs. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-08, CL-WF-22, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: REHOSPITALIZATION REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Monthly Rehospitalization Review Report; per-event preventability disposition; rate trend chart; PIP trigger memo.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Per-event review ≤5 business days of event notification.
workflows.escalationLogic: Rate above CMS Star Rating benchmark → mandatory PIP via QA-WF-04. Preventable pattern → policy update via EN-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: event roster, preventability dispositions, rate calc, PIP triggers. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-19, QA-WF-04, QA-WF-08, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: PATIENT OUTCOME MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Monthly Outcome Dashboard; trend charts; PIP candidate list.
workflows.sla: Monthly, by 10th business day; feeds QA-WF-02 publication.
workflows.escalationLogic: Outcome regression >5% MoM → mandatory PIP via QA-WF-04. Star-Rating impacting trend → QA-WF-09. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: dataset hash, reconciliation evidence, trend charts, PIP triggers. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-05, CL-WF-27, QA-WF-02, QA-WF-04, QA-WF-09, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: MISSED VISIT / UTILIZATION AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Missed Visit / Utilization Audit Report; LUPA risk register; utilization deviation list; CAPs.
workflows.sla: Monthly. CAPs ≤5 business days.
workflows.escalationLogic: LUPA rate >threshold → FN-WF-15 + QA-WF-07. Frequent missed visits same clinician → HR-WF-09. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: missed-visit roster, makeup status, LUPA register, CAPs. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-20, QA-WF-07, FN-WF-15, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: ORDERS & CARE PLAN ALIGNMENT AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Orders/POC Alignment Audit Report; defect register; CAP queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Verbal-order signature backlog cleared within audit cycle.
workflows.escalationLogic: Verbal-order backlog >14 days → physician escalation, billing hold via FN-WF-15. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-14.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: sampled episodes, defect register, verbal-order backlog, CAPs. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-06, CL-WF-07, CO-WF-14, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: INTAKE & REFERRAL QUALIFICATION
workflows.outputs: Referral log, intake packet delivered, eligibility verification evidence, acceptance/decline record, scheduled SOC.
workflows.sla: SOC within 48 hours of referral (internal standard — unless ordered later by physician). Decline logged within 24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: Incomplete referral → Intake Coord requests missing items; if not resolved within 24h, escalate to Clinical Manager. Out-of-scope referral → formal decline with referral back to appropriate provider; patient continuity of care documented.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-referral file with: referral, eligibility checks, scope assessment, accept/decline decision, physician order. Non-admit log complete with rationale.

workflows.title: HOMEBOUND STATUS DETERMINATION
workflows.outputs: Completed checklist in chart; narrative evidence; audit results.
workflows.sla: Every SOC, recert, material change.
workflows.escalationLogic: No longer homebound → discharge planning initiated; billing stops until discharge; physician notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: Each episode chart shows homebound documentation; audit log current.

workflows.title: FACE-TO-FACE ENCOUNTER CAPTURE & VERIFICATION
workflows.outputs: F2F encounter in chart; billing release signal.
workflows.sla: Completion before claim submission; no retroactive fabrication.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-compliant F2F → claim held; Compliance Officer informed; refund/denial process triggered if claim already submitted.
workflows.auditRequirements: F2F in every Medicare-billed chart; pre-bill edit evidence.

workflows.title: START OF CARE (SOC) COMPREHENSIVE ASSESSMENT
primaryRoles: Admitting RN (or PT for therapy-only case under state scope)
workflows.outputs: Complete SOC assessment packet; OASIS; initial POC; signed consents.
workflows.sla: SOC within 48h of referral (best practice) or per physician order. OASIS within 5 days of SOC (CoP). POC within 5 days; physician signature within 30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: SOC delay → Scheduler + Clinical Mgr notified immediately; new scheduled date; documented rationale in chart.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-chart: SOC note, OASIS, POC, consents, F2F, homebound, meds — all timestamped.

workflows.title: OASIS COMPLETION, QA, TRANSMISSION & CORRECTION
workflows.outputs: QA'd OASIS; transmission confirmation; correction records; competency attestations.
workflows.sla: Transmission within 30 days of M0090 assessment completion (42 CFR § 484.45). Correction per CMS rules.
workflows.escalationLogic: Transmission failure → OASIS Coord + IT within 24h; escalate to CMS QIES help if system issue. Pattern of coding errors → PIP and retraining.
workflows.auditRequirements: QA checklist per OASIS; transmission log complete; clinician competency file current.

workflows.title: PLAN OF CARE (POC / CMS-485) ESTABLISHMENT & PHYSICIAN SIGNATURE
workflows.outputs: Signed POC in chart; signature tracking log current; coordination log.
workflows.sla:
- POC draft within 5 days of SOC.
- Physician signature within 30 days of SOC (CMS requirement).
- Review/revise every 60 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Day 21 post-SOC: Clinical Manager contacts physician. Day 30: escalate to Administrator. Day 45: billing held; documented physician noncooperation.
workflows.auditRequirements: Every active episode has signed POC; tracking log current.

workflows.title: PHYSICIAN ORDERS & VERBAL ORDER AUTHENTICATION
workflows.outputs: Signed orders in chart; verbal order log current; signature tracking log.
workflows.sla: Physician signature within 30 days (CoP). Verbal order entered same day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Day 21: Clinical Manager outreach; Day 30: Administrator-level outreach; Day 45: billing suspended for non-signed.
workflows.auditRequirements: Each order traceable: chart → verbal log → signature tracking → signed order.

workflows.title: COORDINATION OF CARE & MULTIDISCIPLINARY COMMUNICATION
workflows.outputs: Coordination log; conference notes; milestone tracker; physician communications.
workflows.sla: Same-day notification of significant changes; weekly or monthly case conferences for complex patients.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unreachable physician for urgent change → supervising physician / cover / ED referral. Lack of response → documented and escalated to Clinical Manager.
workflows.auditRequirements: Each chart shows coordination entries; case conferences for complex cases documented.

workflows.title: SKILLED VISIT DOCUMENTATION (RN / PT / OT / SLP / MSW)
workflows.outputs: Completed, authenticated visit notes; amendment log; QA audit results.
workflows.sla: Note signed within 24 hours of visit (internal standard); physician order changes same day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unsigned notes >48h → Clinical Manager; pattern → clinician retraining + performance action.
workflows.auditRequirements: Monthly QA sample; notes timestamped with authentication; amendment log.

workflows.title: HOME HEALTH AIDE SERVICES & SUPERVISION
workflows.outputs: Aide visit records; RN supervisory notes; direct observation forms; remediation records.
workflows.sla:
- Skilled-patient: 14-day supervision; annual direct observation.
- Aide-only: 60-day RN visit; semiannual direct observation.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed supervision window → Clinical Manager alerted; visit scheduled within 7 days; variance documented. Deficiency → retraining mandatory; aide removed from patient until re-evaluated.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-aide file with written instructions, supervisory records for each window, direct observation forms, competency evidence.

workflows.title: ANNUAL AIDE IN-SERVICE TRAINING (≥12 HOURS)
workflows.outputs: Completion records per aide; hour log ≥12 in window; competency records.
workflows.sla: 12 hours every 12 months per aide; no lapse allowed (no grace for CoP).
workflows.escalationLogic: Aide approaching lapse → mandatory training scheduled; if not complete by due date → remove from patient assignments until completion.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-aide training record with hours, topics, RN supervisor, dates.

workflows.title: MEDICATION MANAGEMENT & RECONCILIATION
workflows.outputs: Reconciliation worksheets; issue resolution records; education records; MARs.
workflows.sla: Same-day physician contact for issues; 2-day follow-up; MAR current.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unresolved issues ≥48h → Clinical Manager + physician escalation. Adverse drug event → QA-WF-05 RCA.
workflows.auditRequirements: Reconciliation on every SOC/ROC/Recert; physician contact log; resolution evidence.

workflows.title: WOUND CARE & SPECIALTY CLINICAL PROTOCOLS
workflows.outputs: Wound flow sheets; photos (if consented); specialty logs; physician communications.
workflows.sla: Per visit; escalation same day for deterioration.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-healing >2 weeks or deterioration → physician + wound specialist within 24h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-wound trend data; photos (with consent); physician contacts; outcomes tracked.

workflows.title: INFECTION CONTROL AT POINT OF CARE
workflows.outputs: Precautions checklist per visit (sampled); surveillance reports; exposure management records; training records.
workflows.sla: Every visit; reportable disease per statute; outbreak per IP protocol.
workflows.escalationLogic: Outbreak / cluster → RM-WF-06 activation; public health notification.
workflows.auditRequirements: Audit sample of infection control compliance; surveillance logs; exposures.

workflows.title: TELEHEALTH SERVICE DELIVERY
workflows.outputs: Consent, visit notes, platform audit.
workflows.sla: Consent before first encounter; note same day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Technology failure → fall back to in-person within POC-frequency constraints.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-patient telehealth consent; BAA for platform; visit notes.

workflows.title: PATIENT RIGHTS, ADMISSION CONSENT & ADVANCE DIRECTIVES
workflows.outputs: Signed rights, consent, advance directive, NPP, attestations in chart.
workflows.sla: At/before first visit.
workflows.escalationLogic: Refusal / incapacity → Social Work / Surrogate decision-maker; documented in chart; physician notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: Every chart shows all admission documents signed/dated.

workflows.title: PATIENT / FAMILY EDUCATION
workflows.outputs: Education records; caregiver training records; interpreter usage log.
workflows.sla: Each teaching event documented at visit.
workflows.escalationLogic: High-risk non-mastery → added teaching visits; MSW/caregiver engagement; potential safety plan.
workflows.auditRequirements: Education/caregiver records traceable; interpreter log.

workflows.title: RECERTIFICATION / RESUMPTION OF CARE (ROC)
workflows.outputs: Completed recert/ROC OASIS; updated POC; physician recert confirmation.
workflows.sla: Recert in last 5 days of episode; ROC within 48h of return knowledge.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed window → Clinical Manager; document rationale; may impact billing.
workflows.auditRequirements: Timing of OASIS and POC signatures visible per episode.

workflows.title: TRANSFER / DISCHARGE PLANNING & EXECUTION
workflows.outputs: DC notice, DC assessment, summary, OASIS, chart closure.
workflows.sla: 2-day notice; DC assessment at DC; OASIS transmission 30 days; chart closure 14 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Patient objects → Social Work; discharge appeal information provided; process documented.
workflows.auditRequirements: DC documents, OASIS, summary, physician communication per chart.

workflows.title: MISSED VISIT MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Missed visit log; rescheduling evidence; frequency tracker; weather log.
workflows.sla: Same-day documentation; 24-hour rescheduling.
workflows.escalationLogic: Three consecutive missed visits / patient refusal → Clinical Manager + physician; discharge consideration if appropriate.
workflows.auditRequirements: Missed visit log complete; reasons documented; reschedule evidence.

workflows.title: CLINICAL RECORD COMPLETION & AMENDMENT
workflows.outputs: Completed charts; QA audit results; amendment records.
workflows.sla: Notes within 24h; episode closure within 30 days of DC.
workflows.escalationLogic: Pattern of incomplete records → clinician retraining / performance action; systemic → PIP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Audit sample monthly; amendment logs; full chart retrievable within 4 business days (§ 484.110).

workflows.title: ABUSE / NEGLECT / EXPLOITATION REPORTING
workflows.outputs: Incident report, agency submission confirmation, safety plan, follow-up evidence.
workflows.sla: Reporting per state law (typically telephonic immediately; written ≤2 working days).
workflows.escalationLogic: Life-threat → 911 immediately; Administrator + Legal within 4h. Staff perpetrator → HR + Compliance + law enforcement.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-case file with all reports, agency confirmations, safety plans; mandatory reporter attestations on file (HR-FM-033).

workflows.title: PATIENT COMPLAINT / GRIEVANCE HANDLING
workflows.outputs: Grievance log, investigation file, resolution letter, trend reports.
workflows.sla: Ack ≤5 days; resolution ≤30 days (or per state law if tighter).
workflows.escalationLogic: Allegation of abuse/neglect → CL-WF-22. Allegation of HIPAA → CO-WF-10. Regulator complaint → CO-WF-05.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-complaint file; aggregate trend evidence; QAPI Committee Meeting Minutes (QA-FM-001), Compliance Committee Meeting Minutes (CO-FM-024), and Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005) evidencing quarterly aggregate reporting.

workflows.title: PEDIATRIC / PALLIATIVE / HIGH-RISK SPECIALTY PATHWAYS
workflows.outputs: Specialty assessment, customized POC, enhanced monitoring records, caregiver training.
workflows.sla: Per specialty protocol; prior auth per payer.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material change or deterioration → physician + specialist + Clinical Manager within 24h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Specialty documentation in chart; conference records; outcomes tracked.

workflows.title: CLINICIAN COMPETENCY VALIDATION (INCL. OASIS)
workflows.outputs: Competency files per person; remediation records.
workflows.sla: Initial before independent practice; annual per anniversary; post-event within 30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Competency failure → remove from related task; formal remediation; if not achievable → job change or termination.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-person competency file; retention per HR policy (typically life of employment + 7 years).

workflows.title: PRE-BILL CLAIMS AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Daily pre-bill disposition log; weekly Pre-Bill Claims Audit Report; per-defect category trend; hold register.
workflows.sla: Daily evaluation. Weekly report by Tuesday for prior week. No claim released to FN-WF-04 without disposition.
workflows.escalationLogic: Hold rate >5% → systemic CAP via CO-WF-04. Repeat clinician/coder defects → HR-WF-09 + CL-WF-25. Patterns suggesting upcoding → CO-WF-08 FWA. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and FN-WF-15.
workflows.auditRequirements: Daily disposition log retained ≥10 years (FCA SOL). Weekly report linked to FN-WF-04, FN-WF-15, CO-WF-08. Sample-frame size, defect register, hold disposition, sign-off captured per cycle.

workflows.title: POST-BILL CLAIMS AUDIT
approvalRoles: Governing Body informed for material findings
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Post-Bill Audit Report; sample disposition; overpayment register; OIG self-disclosure trigger memo (if applicable).
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Overpayment refund initiated within 60 days of identification per FN-WF-08.
workflows.escalationLogic: Error rate >5% → expanded sample; systemic CAP via CO-WF-04. Material overpayment → FN-WF-08 + CO-WF-16 (OIG self-disclosure). Pattern of upcoding → CO-WF-08. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: frame, sample IDs, scoring sheets, overpayment register, refund evidence, sign-offs. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to FN-WF-04, FN-WF-08, CO-WF-16, CO-WF-23, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: DOCUMENTATION VS BILLING RECONCILIATION
workflows.outputs: Monthly Reconciliation Report; variance register; refund queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Refund initiated within 60 days per FN-WF-08.
workflows.escalationLogic: Variance >2% → systemic CAP via CO-WF-04. Pattern → CO-WF-08 FWA review. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-14.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: dataset hashes, variance register, refund evidence. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to FN-WF-04, FN-WF-08, CO-WF-14, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: CODING ACCURACY REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Per-Coder Accuracy Scorecard; aggregate defect register; remediation queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Per-coder remediation initiated within 5 business days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Per-coder accuracy <90% → mandatory retraining via HR-WF-07. Material HIPPS impact → FN-WF-15. Pattern of upcoding → CO-WF-08 FWA. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: sample IDs, per-coder scores, HIPPS impact, retraining evidence. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-05, CO-WF-23, FN-WF-15, HR-WF-07, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: FWA MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Weekly risk indicator dashboard; quarterly FWA monitoring report; investigation register; OIG self-disclosure triggers.
workflows.sla: Continuous. Quarterly report ≥7 days before quarterly Governing Body meeting (GV-WF-01).
workflows.escalationLogic: Material finding → CO-WF-16 OIG self-disclosure within 60 days of identification. Excluded individual found → HR-WF-09 + immediate removal. Findings feed QA-WF-03, CO-WF-22, GV-WF-01.
workflows.auditRequirements: Continuous log: risk indicators, investigations, dispositions, self-disclosures, exclusion screening evidence. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to CO-WF-03, CO-WF-08, CO-WF-15, CO-WF-16, HR-WF-15, GV-WF-01, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: AUTHORIZATION / ELIGIBILITY AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Monthly Authorization/Eligibility Audit Report; hold register; denial trend.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Holds applied within 24h of detection.
workflows.escalationLogic: Denial rate >2% → CAP; pattern → FN-WF-15. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: roster, hold register, denial trend, sign-off. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-01, FN-WF-04, FN-WF-15, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: REVENUE CYCLE EXCEPTION REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Monthly RCM Exception Report; denial trend; ADR/credit balance/refund register.
workflows.sla: Monthly. ADR responses within CMS deadline; refunds within 60 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed ADR deadline → automatic claim denial; CAP via FN-WF-06. Refund delay > 60 days → CO-WF-16. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: exception register, dispositions, evidence of ADR/refund/credit-balance closure. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to FN-WF-05, FN-WF-06, FN-WF-07, FN-WF-08, FN-WF-15, CO-WF-16, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: CORRECTIVE ACTION TRACKING
workflows.outputs: CAP register (live); weekly status; monthly CAP report; overdue escalations.
workflows.sla: Continuous. Monthly report by 5th business day. Overdue escalations within 24h of breach.
workflows.escalationLogic: Overdue >30 days → Administrator + Governing Body via GV-WF-01. Repeat overdue same owner → HR-WF-09. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Append-only CAP register. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to every audit workflow plus CO-WF-04, CO-WF-22, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: ANNUAL COMPLIANCE PROGRAM ATTESTATION
workflows.outputs: Signed annual attestation, evidence binder, Governing Body minutes, published staff summary.
workflows.sla: Annual completion ≤30 days before FY end; Governing Body acceptance at annual meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Incomplete attestation: Administrator notified; remediation plan within 14 days; reported to Compliance Committee. Material weakness: mandatory CAP and quarterly Governing Body updates.
workflows.auditRequirements: OIG auditors will trace: each of 7 Elements → evidence → metrics → Board acceptance. Each artifact timestamped.

workflows.title: CODE OF CONDUCT ACKNOWLEDGMENT
workflows.outputs: Signed acknowledgments on file; aggregate completion dashboard.
workflows.sla: Day 1 of employment; annual by anniversary; 30 days post-revision.
workflows.escalationLogic: Overdue ≥14 days → Manager notified; ≥30 days → HR disciplinary action; continued non-compliance → termination of access per IT-WF (revocation).
workflows.auditRequirements: 100% acknowledgment traceable per person per cycle; retention ≥7 years post-separation.

workflows.title: COMPLIANCE HOTLINE INTAKE & INVESTIGATION
approvalRoles: Governing Body for findings with material exposure.
workflows.outputs: Case file (intake, triage, investigation, findings, CAP, closure), retaliation-check record, aggregate hotline report.
workflows.sla: Triage ≤3 business days; investigation ≤60 days (30 for priority); CAP within 30 days of findings; OIG Self-Disclosure trigger review within 60 days of credible determination (see CO-WF-16).
workflows.escalationLogic: Priority 1 (patient harm, fraud, HIPAA breach): immediate notice to Administrator + Legal; investigation resources deployed within 24h. Retaliation indicated: immediate HR protective measures.
workflows.auditRequirements: Each case traceable: intake → triage → investigation → findings → CAP → closure → retaliation follow-up. Retention ≥10 years.

workflows.title: INTERNAL COMPLIANCE AUDIT CYCLE
workflows.outputs: Approved audit calendar, audit reports, CAPs, overpayment refund evidence, quarterly committee summary.
workflows.sla: Annual calendar pre-FY; audit report draft ≤14 days; CAP ≤30 days; overpayment refund ≤60 days of identification (per ACA Section 6402 / 42 USC 1320a-7k).
workflows.escalationLogic: Findings indicating systemic fraud or pattern billing error → escalate to Administrator + Legal + Governing Body within 72 hours; OIG Self-Disclosure assessment (CO-WF-16).
workflows.auditRequirements: Work programs, fieldwork evidence, findings, CAPs, closure documentation traceable; refund checks attached to FN-FM-006.

workflows.title: EXTERNAL SURVEY / INSPECTION RESPONSE & PLAN OF CORRECTION
workflows.outputs: Completed PoC (CMS-approved), corrective action evidence, revisit survey results, findings closed in tracker.
workflows.sla: PoC submission ≤10 calendar days of 2567 receipt (standard CMS). Corrective actions per PoC dates (typically 30–60 days). Condition-Level revisit typically within 45 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Immediate Jeopardy finding → removal of IJ within regulatory timeline (typically 23 days); executive Governing Body session within 24 hours. Termination notice → emergency Governing Body + Legal engagement.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full survey file: 2567, PoC submissions, acceptance letter, evidence per tag, revisit result. Retain 10 years.

workflows.title: REGULATORY CHANGE MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Impact assessment, crosswalk, updated policies (versioned), training records, system change records.
workflows.sla: Identification ≤7 days of publication; implementation before statutory effective date (never later).
workflows.escalationLogic: Effective date impossible → Compliance Officer notifies Administrator + Governing Body Chair within 7 days; documented exception with Legal; interim controls instituted.
workflows.auditRequirements: Each regulatory change trackable end-to-end from publication to training to system change; versioned evidence.

workflows.title: ANTI-KICKBACK & STARK RELATIONSHIP REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Signed attestations, FMV documentation, legal memos, register entries, annual review evidence.
workflows.sla: Before execution; annual reviews by anniversary.
workflows.escalationLogic: FMV misalignment or safe-harbor failure → arrangement held for legal review; material concern → Governing Body informed; self-disclosure assessment if already executed.
workflows.auditRequirements: Arrangement register complete; each arrangement has: contract, FMV, disclosures, legal memo, attestations, annual review. Minimum 10-year retention.

workflows.title: FRAUD, WASTE & ABUSE (FWA) TRAINING & MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Training rosters (≥95% completion target), analytics reports, investigation tickets.
workflows.sla: ≤90 days of hire; annual refresh; quarterly analytics.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-completion >30 days past due: HR progressive discipline. Analytic outlier → investigation within 14 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Training completion per person per cycle; analytic report archive; investigation linkage.

workflows.title: HIPAA WORKFORCE TRAINING
workflows.outputs: Training rosters, phishing simulation reports, completion dashboard.
workflows.sla: Within 30 days of hire; annually; ≤60 days of material change.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-completion → HR discipline; continued non-compliance → access revocation (IT-WF) and termination.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-person completion traceable ≥6 years (HIPAA retention).

workflows.title: HIPAA BREACH ASSESSMENT, INVESTIGATION & NOTIFICATION
workflows.outputs: Breach Risk Assessment, individual notifications (proof of mailing), HHS submission receipt, media notice (if ≥500), state AG notices, corrective action records, board briefing.
workflows.sla:
- Risk assessment ≤10 business days.
- Individual notices ≤60 calendar days of discovery.
- 500+: HHS and media "without unreasonable delay" — treat as 60 days max.
- <500 annual HHS submission within 60 days of end of calendar year.
- California: state AG notice within defined windows (typically ≤30 days for large breaches).
workflows.escalationLogic: 500+ affected → Administrator + Legal + Chair within 24 hours of determination. Criminal element → Legal + law enforcement. Media-worthy → Chair + PR.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-incident file: detection → containment → risk assessment → determination → notifications → CAP. 6-year minimum retention.

workflows.title: BUSINESS ASSOCIATE AGREEMENT (BAA) LIFECYCLE
workflows.outputs: Signed BAAs, BAA register, annual review evidence, destruction certificates on termination.
workflows.sla: BAA before PHI exchange; annual review; amendment ≤60 days of rule change.
workflows.escalationLogic: PHI exchanged without BAA → immediate containment + CO-WF-10 assessment.
workflows.auditRequirements: BAA for each BA traceable; register current; destruction certificates on file.

workflows.title: PATIENT AUTHORIZATION & ACCOUNTING OF DISCLOSURES (HIPAA + CMIA)
workflows.outputs: NPP receipt, authorizations on file, release logs, accounting of disclosures, access/amendment/restriction response records.
workflows.sla: NPP at first visit; Access 30 days; Amendment 60 days; Accounting 60 days; all extensions max once with written notice.
workflows.escalationLogic: CMIA Sensitive Category without valid authorization → escalate to Compliance Officer before any release. Denial risk → Legal review.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-patient authorization file, NPP log, disclosure log sufficient to support 6-year accounting.

workflows.title: RECORDS RETENTION & DESTRUCTION
workflows.outputs: Retention schedule (current); destruction certificates on file; hold register.
workflows.sla: Clinical records: ≥5 years post-discharge (42 CFR § 484.110) OR longer per state/payer. HIPAA 6 years. Pediatric: per state (commonly age of majority + 5 years).
workflows.escalationLogic: Destruction under hold: immediate stop, incident investigation, potential spoliation claim. Lost records: CO-WF-10 assessment.
workflows.auditRequirements: Retention schedule current; destruction certificates per batch; hold register; reconciliation of inventory to destructions.

workflows.title: DOCUMENTATION ALIGNMENT AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Audit report, deficiency log, amendment records, refund evidence, training records.
workflows.sla: Quarterly audits; amendments within policy window; refunds ≤60 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Pattern of misalignment (upcoding, phantom visits) → investigation + legal + self-disclosure assessment.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-sample worksheet, findings, CAPs, refunds; retention 10 years.

workflows.title: OIG/SAM EXCLUSION SCREENING (MONTHLY)
workflows.outputs: Monthly screening evidence, termination records (if match), refund evidence, OIG disclosure (if applicable).
workflows.sla: Monthly (no miss). Pre-hire. 60-day refund.
workflows.escalationLogic: Confirmed match: Administrator + Legal + Governing Body within 24 hours.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-month completed screen log; per-match investigation; per-refund file.

workflows.title: OIG SELF-DISCLOSURE PROTOCOL
workflows.outputs: Disclosure submission, OIG correspondence, settlement agreement, CAP/CIA implementation evidence, refund.
workflows.sla: 60-day refund rule preserved; SDP timing per OIG.
workflows.escalationLogic: Declination/referral to DOJ → Legal re-assesses strategy; criminal exposure triggers criminal counsel.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full disclosure file: investigation → calculation → decision memo → Governing Body authorization → submission → settlement → CAP. Permanent retention.

workflows.title: HIPAA SECURITY RISK ANALYSIS (ANNUAL)
workflows.outputs: Annual SRA report, remediation plan, completed mitigations, Board acceptance.
workflows.sla: Annual SRA; remediation plan ≤30 days; high-risk controls prioritized by severity.
workflows.escalationLogic: High-risk finding without reasonable mitigation → escalate; compensating controls documented; executive risk acceptance required.
workflows.auditRequirements: SRA with methodology, scope, findings, remediation; Board minutes evidencing review.

workflows.title: AI TOOL USE REQUEST & GOVERNANCE
workflows.outputs: Approved use case, impact assessment, BAA, monitoring evidence, annual reassessment.
workflows.sla: Pre-procurement; annual re-review; incident-triggered review within 14 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Safety/bias incident → immediate pause; investigation; Governing Body briefing.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-tool file: request, impact assessment, BAA, approvals, monitoring, annual review.

workflows.title: MEDICARE CoP COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION
workflows.outputs: Completed checklist, gap log, CAPs.
workflows.sla: Quarterly; pre-survey; post-regulatory change.
workflows.escalationLogic: CoP gap → CAP within 30 days; Condition-Level gap → executive escalation within 72 hours.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-quarter checklist, CAP evidence.

workflows.title: COMPLIANCE COMMITTEE MEETINGS (MONTHLY)
workflows.outputs: Minutes, action log, escalations to Governing Body.
workflows.sla: Monthly; minutes ≤14 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed meeting >45 days: escalation; immediate session scheduled.
workflows.auditRequirements: 12 months of minutes available; action log closure tracked.

workflows.title: CALIFORNIA CMIA DISCLOSURE & SENSITIVE CATEGORY HANDLING
workflows.outputs: CMIA receipts, disclosure log, violation files, training records.
workflows.sla: HIPAA assessment 24h; CMIA assessment 48h; patient complaint response 14 days; resolution 30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: CMIA violation → Legal within 48h; Governing Body next meeting unless severity warrants emergency session.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-disclosure log entry with basis; sensitive-category flag evidence; violation file retention 6 years.

workflows.title: COMPLIANCE METRICS & QUARTERLY REPORT TO GOVERNING BODY
workflows.outputs: Quarterly compliance report; Board minutes.
workflows.sla: Every quarter; annual attestation at year-end meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material adverse trend → executive session; escalation to Chair pre-meeting.
workflows.auditRequirements: Quarterly reports retained 7+ years; minutes confirming review.

workflows.title: POLICY LIFECYCLE
approvalRoles: Administrator + Compliance for others per matrix
workflows.outputs: Approved policy, signed sign-offs, publication record, acknowledgments, training evidence.
workflows.sla: Stakeholder review 15 days; Legal 10 days; publication same day as approval.
workflows.escalationLogic: Stalled policy > 60 days → Compliance Officer; failed Board approval → rework timeline.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full lifecycle evidence per policy retained 6+ years beyond retirement.

workflows.title: ANNUAL POLICY REVIEW (FULL FRAMEWORK)
workflows.outputs: Reviewed/ updated policies, reaffirmations, annual report.
workflows.sla: Each policy reviewed at minimum annually; tier-specific cadences may require 6-month or triennial.
workflows.escalationLogic: Overdue reviews > 30 days → Administrator; > 90 days → Governing Body.
workflows.auditRequirements: Annual tracker + reaffirmations + updated versions.

workflows.title: UNIVERSAL POLICY ACKNOWLEDGMENT
workflows.outputs: Signed acknowledgments; completion reports.
workflows.sla: Day 1; at each material update; annual cycle.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-completion > 14 days → access suspension (IT-WF-04) + supervisor action.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-staff acknowledgment file retained 6+ years.

workflows.title: MASTER POLICY INDEX / TAXONOMY REGISTER
workflows.outputs: Current register; reconciliation; published views.
workflows.sla: Same-day update; monthly reconciliation.
workflows.escalationLogic: Policies out-of-sync → Compliance Officer CAP within 30 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Register history; reconciliation reports.

workflows.title: REGULATORY CHANGE MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Scan log; impact analyses; bulletins; updated policies.
workflows.sla: Impact analysis ≤10 business days; implementation by effective date.
workflows.escalationLogic: Compliance date unmet → Administrator + Board; remediation CAP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Scan logs, impact analyses, update evidence retained 6+ years.

workflows.title: POLICY VERSION CONTROL & ARCHIVE
workflows.outputs: Archive register; version history; portal current.
workflows.sla: Immediate on publication; 6+ year retention.
workflows.escalationLogic: Broken links / outdated visible version → IT + Compliance Officer within 24h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Archive register; ability to produce any prior version promptly.

workflows.title: ENTERPRISE DOCUMENT CONTROL & FORMS LIBRARY GOVERNANCE
workflows.outputs: Current Forms Index, audit reports.
workflows.sla: Gaps closed ≤15 days; quarterly audit.
workflows.escalationLogic: Gap persists > 30 days → Administrator + Compliance Committee.
workflows.auditRequirements: Index history; audit reports retained.

workflows.title: RECORDS RETENTION & DESTRUCTION SCHEDULE
workflows.outputs: Retention schedule; legal holds; destruction logs.
workflows.sla: Per schedule; legal hold immediate.
workflows.escalationLogic: Destruction without authorization → Investigation (CO-WF-05) + Legal.
workflows.auditRequirements: Retention schedule, destruction logs retained per schedule + legal hold registry.

workflows.title: ENTERPRISE MANDATORY EVENTS CALENDAR
workflows.outputs: Master calendar; reminders; completion reports.
workflows.sla: Calendar in place by fiscal year start; monthly report.
workflows.escalationLogic: Overdue event → Owner + Compliance; > 30 days → Administrator; > 60 days → Governing Body.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full completion trail with artifacts retained 6+ years.

workflows.title: ENTERPRISE KPI / METRICS REPORTING
workflows.outputs: Monthly dashboards; Board briefings.
workflows.sla: Monthly; quarterly Board view.
workflows.escalationLogic: KPI outside control limits → RCA + CAP (PIP or dept plan).
workflows.auditRequirements: Dashboards, supporting data, Board minutes retained.

workflows.title: ENTERPRISE INTERNAL AUDIT & MANAGEMENT REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Audit reports, CAPs, Management Review minutes.
workflows.sla: Per plan; quarterly reviews.
workflows.escalationLogic: High-risk finding → Management Review within 7 days; Board if material.
workflows.auditRequirements: Plan, results, CAPs, reviews retained 10 years.

workflows.title: CROSS-DOMAIN RISK REGISTER CONSOLIDATION
workflows.outputs: Enterprise risk register; quarterly Board briefing.
workflows.sla: Quarterly.
workflows.escalationLogic: Critical unmitigated risk → emergency Board session.
workflows.auditRequirements: Register history, Committee minutes, Board acceptance.

workflows.title: ANNUAL COMPLIANCE ATTESTATION & MANAGEMENT CERTIFICATION
workflows.outputs: Departmental attestations; enterprise certification; Board acceptance.
workflows.sla: Annual.
workflows.escalationLogic: Disclosed material issue → Compliance Committee + Legal immediately; 60-day overpayment clock (FN-WF-08) may trigger.
workflows.auditRequirements: Signed attestations retained 10 years (FCA look-back).

workflows.title: ANNUAL OPERATING BUDGET & INSTITUTIONAL PLAN
workflows.outputs: Approved budget; institutional plan; **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** recording approval vote; **Finance Committee Meeting Minutes** (interim EN-FM-021 pending new FN-FM-014).
workflows.sla: Approved before fiscal year start; amendments per variance threshold.
workflows.escalationLogic: >10% variance → mandatory amendment + Committee + Board review.
workflows.auditRequirements: Board-approved budget with signatures; amendments; variance reports.

workflows.title: MONTHLY FINANCIAL CLOSE & VARIANCE REPORTING
workflows.outputs: Monthly financials, variance report, **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** recording quarterly Board briefing and any material-variance decisions.
workflows.sla: Close within 10 business days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material variance → CFO within 3 days; Administrator within 7; Board if continues.
workflows.auditRequirements: Close checklists, reconciliations, variance reports retained 7 years.

workflows.title: COST REPORT PREPARATION & FILING
workflows.outputs: Filed cost report, certification, MAC correspondence.
workflows.sla: Filed within 5 months of FYE (or approved extension).
workflows.escalationLogic: Late filing → payment suspension; immediate CFO+Admin+Legal engagement.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full working papers, filed cost report, MAC correspondence retained per CMS requirements.

workflows.title: HH PPS CLAIM SUBMISSION (NOA / FINAL CLAIM)
workflows.outputs: NOA confirmation, submitted claims, RAs, penalty logs.
workflows.sla: NOA ≤5 days; final claim per MAC windows.
workflows.escalationLogic: Claim held >5 days: Billing Mgr + CFO; NOA late → penalty escalated; systemic denial → CAP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Pre-bill audit evidence, NOA proofs, claim/RA reconciliation, 10-year retention (FCA).

workflows.title: CLAIM DENIAL & APPEAL MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Denial log; RCA; appeals with outcomes; trend reporting.
workflows.sla: Redetermination ≤120 days; Reconsideration ≤180; ALJ ≤60; Council ≤60.
workflows.escalationLogic: Denial rate >5% → Compliance + QAPI PIP (QA-WF-01); systemic error → coding training.
workflows.auditRequirements: Appeals file per claim; trend analysis; linkage to PIP.

workflows.title: ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTATION REQUEST (ADR) RESPONSE
workflows.outputs: ADR log, assembled record, submission proof.
workflows.sla: Per ADR (typically 45 days); never late.
workflows.escalationLogic: ADR >30% denial post-audit → Compliance + QAPI PIP; training.
workflows.auditRequirements: ADR log; complete packages retained 10 years.

workflows.title: CREDIT BALANCE REPORTING (CMS-838)
workflows.outputs: CMS-838 filed (with or without credits), refund records, confirmations.
workflows.sla: Within 30 days of quarter end.
workflows.escalationLogic: Credit balance >90 days → CFO investigate root cause; pattern → FN-WF-08.
workflows.auditRequirements: Quarterly reports, CMS-838 filings retained.

workflows.title: 60-DAY OVERPAYMENT IDENTIFICATION & RETURN
workflows.outputs: Quantification, disclosure memo, refund transmittal, CAP, **Compliance Committee Meeting Minutes (CO-FM-024)**, **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)**.
workflows.sla: 60 days from identification (after reasonable diligence, typically up to 6 months).
workflows.escalationLogic: Suspected fraud → Legal + Governing Body immediately; DOJ contact considered; OIG SDP pathway evaluated.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full file: identification, diligence, quantification, disclosure memo, refund, CAP. 10-year retention.

workflows.title: ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & BAD DEBT
workflows.outputs: Monthly aging, write-off records, **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** evidencing Board briefing on large write-off bundles.
workflows.sla: Monthly; Medicare bad-debt documentation aligned with cost report cycle.
workflows.escalationLogic: AR days > target → CFO CAP; Medicare bad-debt documentation required for cost report claim.
workflows.auditRequirements: Write-off justifications; aging reports; bad-debt cost-report linkage.

workflows.title: PATIENT BILLING, FINANCIAL COUNSELING & CHARITY CARE
approvalRoles: CFO for charity approvals per threshold
workflows.outputs: Counseling records; charity determinations; adjustments; appeal records.
workflows.sla: Estimate before SOC; charity determination ≤14 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Disputed billing → Patient Complaint (CL-WF-21) + Finance response.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-patient financial file; charity decisions traceable.

workflows.title: ACCOUNTS PAYABLE & VENDOR PAYMENT
workflows.outputs: Payment records; reconciled vendor AR.
workflows.sla: Pay per terms (commonly 30 days).
workflows.escalationLogic: OIG/SAM match at payment: hold payment; Compliance investigation.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-invoice file retained; vendor status evidence.

workflows.title: PAYROLL PROCESSING
workflows.outputs: Payroll registers, tax filings, GL posts.
workflows.sla: Per pay schedule; tax filings per statute.
workflows.escalationLogic: Payroll error → correction run; wage complaint → HR-WF.
workflows.auditRequirements: Payroll records retained per law; tax filings retained 7+ years.

workflows.title: EXTERNAL FINANCIAL AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Audited financials, management letter, CAP, **Audit Committee Meeting Minutes**, **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** ratifying audit result.
workflows.sla: Per fiscal year; before cost-report preparation.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material weakness / fraud finding → immediate Audit Committee + Board; CAP within 30 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Audit files retained 7+ years; management letters.

workflows.title: CHARGEMASTER / RATE REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Approved rate schedule; memo; publication record.
workflows.sla: Annual review; on-demand updates.
workflows.escalationLogic: Rate concerns from private-pay patients → CFO + Compliance; potential FCA if also billed to Medicare at higher rate without proper adjustment.
workflows.auditRequirements: Rate change history; approvals; publication evidence.

workflows.title: RCM SELF-AUDIT & REVENUE INTEGRITY
workflows.outputs: Audit reports, overpayment worksheets, CAPs, **Compliance Committee Meeting Minutes (CO-FM-024)**, and **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** for any ratified material overpayment or disclosure decision.
workflows.sla: Monthly samples; quarterly summary.
workflows.escalationLogic: Systemic error rate >5% → mandatory PIP + broader claim review & potential FN-WF-08 trigger.
workflows.auditRequirements: Sampling methodology, workpapers, reports, CAPs 10 years.

workflows.title: GOVERNING BODY QUARTERLY MEETING & MINUTES
workflows.outputs:
- Signed, approved minutes (GV-FM-005) filed in permanent Governing Body records.
- Updated action item log with owners and due dates.
- Updated policy approval log (EN-FM-008, EN-FM-009 Version Control Change Log).
- Updated roster (GV-FM-011) if membership changed.
- Executive session minutes (GV-FM-022), separately filed, if invoked.
workflows.sla:
- **Regulatory:** Governing Body must meet at least quarterly (§ 484.105(a); enforcement rule GV-GB-001).
- **Internal:** Draft minutes within 14 calendar days (GV-GB-002 enforcement rule).
- **Retention:** Minimum 7 years (GV-GB-002); CMIA/California may extend.
- **Agenda distribution:** ≥7 days pre-meeting (internal best practice).
workflows.escalationLogic:
- **Missed quarter:** Chair receives automatic alert at day 90; emergency meeting scheduled within 14 days; documented in compliance log and reported at next Compliance Committee.
- **Quorum failure:** Secretary notifies Chair within 24 hours; meeting rescheduled within 14 days; treated as continuity risk event.
- **Unresolved action items >2 quarters:** Escalated to Administrator for root-cause; reported to Compliance Committee.
workflows.auditRequirements: Surveyors will verify: (a) minutes for each of the last 8 quarters are present, signed, approved; (b) quorum was met at each meeting; (c) Compliance, QAPI, Risk, and Financial reports are cited in minutes and retained; (d) COI disclosures on file for each member; (e) action items have documented closure. Traceability required: minutes → cited reports → decisions → policy version updates.

workflows.title: ANNUAL GOVERNING BODY SELF-ASSESSMENT
workflows.outputs:
- Aggregate self-assessment report
- Approved improvement plan with owners and timelines
- Updated training plan (GV-FM-024)
- Executive session minutes (GV-FM-022)
workflows.sla:
- **Annual:** Complete within 30 days of fiscal year-end.
- **Training execution:** Planned training completed within 6 months of plan approval.
workflows.escalationLogic:
- Non-response from ≥30% of members: Chair issues follow-up and extends 14 days; repeat failure reviewed as composition issue.
- Plan milestones slipping >30 days: Escalation to Compliance Committee.
workflows.auditRequirements: Traceable: distribution → completion → aggregate → plan → execution → follow-up. Minutes and plan retained 7 years.

workflows.title: ADMINISTRATOR APPOINTMENT / REPLACEMENT / DELEGATION
workflows.outputs:
- Signed Delegation of Authority Agreement (GV-FM-007)
- Governing Body minutes confirming appointment (GV-FM-005)
- Updated organizational chart (GV-FM-003)
- CMS 855A change of information filed
- DOA log entry (GV-FM-017)
- Completed qualification verification (GV-FM-014)
- OIG/SAM clearance (HR-FM-005)
workflows.sla:
- **Regulatory:** Interim Administrator in place immediately; permanent appointed within 30 days of vacancy (GV-GB-001 enforcement rule).
- **CMS 855A:** Report within 30 days.
- **OIG/SAM screening:** Before appointment and monthly thereafter.
workflows.escalationLogic:
- Day 14 vacancy: Chair notifies Governing Body in writing; emergency meeting scheduled.
- Day 21: Formal notice to Compliance Officer for escalation to State Survey Agency as a proactive disclosure if Day 30 will be missed.
- Qualifications fail or OIG match: Candidate rejected; search restarted; incident logged.
workflows.auditRequirements: Personnel file traceable: application → qualifications → OIG screen → Governing Body appointment minutes → delegation agreement → CMS 855A confirmation → orientation completion. Retain per HR policy minimum 7 years post-separation.

workflows.title: CLINICAL MANAGER APPOINTMENT / REPLACEMENT
workflows.outputs: Completed credentialing packet, signed job description, OIG clearance, updated org chart, governing body minutes, CMS 855A confirmation.
workflows.sla:
- **Regulatory:** Qualified Clinical Manager designated at all times; vacancy >30 days is a CoP risk.
- **CMS 855A:** 30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Day 21 vacancy: Administrator briefs Chair; interim Clinical Manager (qualified RN) designated in writing via GV-FM-007.
workflows.auditRequirements: Personnel file, credential verification, OIG screen results, appointment minutes, orientation checklist all retrievable within 4 business days.

workflows.title: ANNUAL INSTITUTIONAL PLAN & BUDGET APPROVAL
workflows.outputs: Approved plan/budget document (v-final), Governing Body minutes, distribution memo, quarterly variance reports.
workflows.sla: Approval ≥30 days before FY start. Quarterly reviews.
workflows.escalationLogic: If approval not secured by Day -30 pre-FY: Chair convenes emergency meeting; interim spending authority limited to prior-year run rate.
workflows.auditRequirements: Approved budget document, minutes of approval, quarterly variance reports retrievable; versioned evidence of amendments.

workflows.title: ANNUAL ACCEPTANCE-TO-SERVICE POLICY REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Approved Acceptance-to-Service policy version; training completion records; updated public service sheet; minutes.
workflows.sla: Annual approval; staff training ≤30 days post-approval.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-admit trend >10% increase quarter-over-quarter triggers interim review (Administrator → Governing Body).
workflows.auditRequirements: Policy version history, approval minutes, training rosters, non-admit log with rationales all retrievable.

workflows.title: ANNUAL PUBLIC SERVICE INFORMATION REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Approved public service description; archived prior versions; media request log.
workflows.sla: Annual review; 30 days to publish updates post-scope change.
workflows.escalationLogic: Any external claim inconsistent with policy → immediate pull-down by Administrator, RCA within 14 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Version history of website/marketing materials; approval minutes; media request log.

workflows.title: CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE (ONBOARDING & ANNUAL)
workflows.outputs: Signed COI forms (current), COI log, recusal documentation in minutes, annual COI report.
workflows.sla: Annual; 30 days for new interests; immediate recusal.
workflows.escalationLogic: Undisclosed conflict discovered → immediate investigation per CO workflows; potential Stark/AKS assessment within 72 hours.
workflows.auditRequirements: All disclosures, recusal records, mitigation plans retrievable 6+ years.

workflows.title: AGENCY LICENSURE & CERTIFICATION RENEWAL MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Current license file, renewal receipts, quarterly status reports.
workflows.sla:
- Quarterly verification (GV-GB-001 enforcement rule).
- 90/60/30 day renewal milestones.
- Change of key personnel: CMS 855A within 30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic:
- Day -45 pre-expiry: Alert Administrator.
- Day -30: Alert Chair.
- Day -14: Emergency action plan.
- Lapse: Immediate cessation of admissions of that service line; notify CMS; regulatory disclosure.
workflows.auditRequirements: License register traceable; quarterly verification evidence on file; renewals & confirmations stored ≥7 years.

workflows.title: CHANGE OF OWNERSHIP / AGENCY CLOSURE
workflows.outputs: Completed CHOW/closure checklist, patient/staff/physician notifications on file, final cost report, records transfer manifest.
workflows.sla: Patient notices ≥30 days; CMS final cost report 150 days; records retention ≥5 years post-discharge.
workflows.escalationLogic: Any failure to meet patient-notice deadlines: Compliance Officer notifies State Survey Agency immediately; additional corrective notices.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full chain of custody for records; evidence of all required notifications; Governing Body minutes authorizing action.

workflows.title: INTERAGENCY / THIRD-PARTY CONTRACT REVIEW
approvalRoles: 000/year OR with referral sources OR management service agreements
workflows.outputs: Signed contract, registry entry, BAA (if applicable), annual performance reviews, renewal approvals.
workflows.sla: Annual performance review; BAA before PHI exchange (no retroactive); Stark/AKS analysis before signing.
workflows.escalationLogic: OIG/SAM hit: do not execute; escalate to Compliance Officer. Stark/AKS flag: Legal review mandatory. Performance >2 CAP cycles: escalate to Governing Body for termination review.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full contract register, executed contracts, BAAs, OIG screen results, Stark/AKS analyses, performance reviews all retrievable and traceable.

workflows.title: STAKEHOLDER / EXTERNAL COMMUNICATION & MEDIA REQUESTS
workflows.outputs: Logged inquiry/response, archived statement, stakeholder grievance resolution record.
workflows.sla: Acknowledgment within 4 hours; substantive response within 24–72 hours depending on type; regulator deadlines per statute.
workflows.escalationLogic: PHI-involved → immediate legal + Compliance Officer. Regulator inquiry → Administrator + Chair + Legal within 4 hours.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full log traceable; each response and approval recorded.

workflows.title: GOVERNING BODY TRAINING & ORIENTATION
workflows.outputs: Completed training log entries, acknowledgment forms, annual completion report.
workflows.sla: Orientation within 60 days; annual refresher by anniversary date.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-completion >30 days past due: Chair notifies member in writing; recorded as governance control deficiency.
workflows.auditRequirements: Log entries with dates, materials, attendance, acknowledgments retained.

workflows.title: EXECUTIVE SESSION MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Public minutes (action summary), separate executive minutes (full record), confidentiality agreements.
workflows.sla: Executive minutes drafted within 14 days; controlled-access retention minimum 7 years.
workflows.escalationLogic: Breach of confidentiality: immediate Compliance Officer notification; investigation under CO-CP workflows; possible HR/legal action.
workflows.auditRequirements: Motion recorded; attendee confidentiality agreements on file; executive minutes retained under separate access controls; evidence of controlled-access log.

workflows.title: TRAINING COMPLIANCE MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Monthly Training Compliance Scorecard; per-employee status; overdue register; escalation queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Overdue >30 days → discipline path within 5 business days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Per-employee overdue >30 days → HR-WF-09. Systemic <95% compliance → CAP via CO-WF-04. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: roster, assignments, completion data, overdue list, escalations, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to HR-WF-03, HR-WF-05, HR-WF-07, CL-WF-11, CO-WF-08, CO-WF-09, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: COMPETENCY VALIDATION & ANNUAL SKILLS REVALIDATION
approvalRoles: Director of Nursing for specialty competencies
workflows.outputs: Annual Competency Scorecard; gap register; retraining queue.
workflows.sla: Annual full revalidation; quarterly verification by 5th business day of new quarter.
workflows.escalationLogic: Failed competency → mandatory retraining (HR-WF-07) and removal from independent practice until revalidated. Repeat failure → HR-WF-09. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: roster, competency evidence per employee, retraining queue, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to CL-WF-25, HR-WF-05, HR-WF-06, HR-WF-07, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: LICENSE & EXCLUSION MONITORING (DEEP AUDIT)
workflows.outputs: Monthly screening evidence pack; license-currency register; hit log with dispositions.
workflows.sla: Monthly screening; same-day suspension on any hit; license renewal action 60 days before expiry.
workflows.escalationLogic: Any exclusion hit → immediate removal + CO-WF-27 + CO-WF-16 self-disclosure if claims billed during exclusion. License lapse → HR-WF-09 + practice removal. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Append-only screening evidence retained ≥10 years (FCA SOL). Per-cycle log: roster hash, screening source, hits, dispositions, sign-off. Cross-referenced to HR-WF-02, HR-WF-04, HR-WF-15, CO-WF-15, CO-WF-16, CO-WF-27, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: STAFF FILE AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly/Annual Staff File Audit Report; per-file gap register; remediation queue.
workflows.sla: Quarterly sample within 7 business days; annual full audit within 30 calendar days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Per-file material gap → remediation within 14 days. Systemic >5% gap → CAP via CO-WF-04. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: roster, sample IDs, scoring, gap register, remediation, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to HR-WF-02, HR-WF-03, HR-WF-04, HR-WF-08, HR-WF-18, HR-WF-19, HR-WF-20, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: JOB REQUISITION & RECRUITMENT
workflows.outputs: Approved requisition; posting records; candidate log; interview scorecards.
workflows.sla: Approval ≤5 days; posting ≤3 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: EEO concern → HR Director + Compliance; OFCCP applicable cases → Legal.
workflows.auditRequirements: Recruiting records retained per EEOC (1 year) / applicable law.

workflows.title: PRE-HIRE SCREENING (BACKGROUND / OIG-SAM / LICENSE)
workflows.outputs: Clear-to-start packet; exclusion screen evidence; license evidence.
workflows.sla: All screens complete before start date.
workflows.escalationLogic:
OIG/SAM/state exclusion match → do not hire; Compliance notified; document per CO-WF-06.
FCRA dispute → hold start; follow FCRA timing.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-employee screening file; exclusion evidence at hire; retained 10+ years.

workflows.title: OFFER, ONBOARDING & NEW-HIRE ORIENTATION
workflows.outputs: Complete personnel file; training records; access approvals; check-ins.
workflows.sla: I-9 per federal timing; orientation within 30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Failed orientation → corrective action or termination (HR-WF-14).
workflows.auditRequirements: Personnel file audit-ready: contract, I-9, screenings, licenses, training, acknowledgments.

workflows.title: PRIMARY SOURCE VERIFICATION & LICENSE TRACKING
workflows.outputs: License register current; PSV evidence per staff; lapse notices.
workflows.sla: PSV pre-start and pre-renewal; lapse suspension same-day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Lapsed license: immediate suspension; clinical coverage reorganized; Administrator + Clinical Manager notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-employee license file; quarterly Board register.

workflows.title: HOME HEALTH AIDE TRAINING & COMPETENCY (42 CFR § 484.80)
workflows.outputs: Competency file per HHA; supervisory visits; in-service log.
workflows.sla: Pre-visit eval; 14-day supervisory; 60-day on-site; 12 hrs/yr in-service; annual re-eval.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed supervisory visit → Clinical Manager immediately + CAP; missed in-service hours → HHA must not provide services until complete.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-HHA competency & training file complete; registry verification; supervisory visit evidence.

workflows.title: SKILLED PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCY & SUPERVISION
workflows.outputs: Per-employee competency file; supervisory records.
workflows.sla: Annual; supervisory cadence per state.
workflows.escalationLogic: Failed competency → retraining or removal from practice; state-board reportable events.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-employee file; supervisory visit logs.

workflows.title: ANNUAL MANDATORY / COMPLIANCE TRAINING
workflows.outputs: Training plan; attendance records; completion matrix; Board report.
workflows.sla: Annual cycle; new hire baseline pre-independent practice.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-completion 14 days post-deadline → suspension from patient/system access until complete.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-employee training record; content evidence (syllabus, sign-in).

workflows.title: PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
workflows.outputs: Evaluations, IDPs, comp records.
workflows.sla: Probation by day 90; annual per cycle.
workflows.escalationLogic: Below-standard rating → HR-WF-09 discipline / PIP; strengths and trends inform succession (GV).
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-employee evaluation file retained.

workflows.title: CORRECTIVE ACTION / PROGRESSIVE DISCIPLINE
workflows.outputs: Disciplinary records; PIP; termination packet.
workflows.sla: Documentation ≤3 days; corrective action ≤5; PIPs per plan.
workflows.escalationLogic:
Allegations of retaliation → CO-WF-07 & Legal immediately.
Protected-class complaint → HR-WF-12 investigation precedes discipline.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-employee file complete; consistency reviews retained.

workflows.title: LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FMLA / CFRA / ADA / PDL)
workflows.outputs: Leave file: request, eligibility, cert, designations, tracking, RTW.
workflows.sla: Eligibility ≤5 days; designation ≤5 days; cert 15 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Denial / dispute → HR Director + Legal; DFEH/EEOC inquiry → Legal.
workflows.auditRequirements: Leave file retained 3 years (FMLA); additional per state.

workflows.title: ACCOMMODATION REQUEST (ADA / FEHA)
workflows.outputs: Accommodation file; implementation evidence.
workflows.sla: Interactive process ≤10 days; determination within reasonable time.
workflows.escalationLogic: Disputed / denied accommodation → Legal + EEOC/DFEH risk mgmt.
workflows.auditRequirements: Interactive-process documentation retained.

workflows.title: DISCRIMINATION / HARASSMENT COMPLAINT INVESTIGATION
primaryRoles: HR Director / outside investigator for exec complaints
workflows.outputs: Case file; interim measures; findings; action; closure.
workflows.sla: Targeted 45 days closure; interim 24h; action 10 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Retaliation concerns → CO-WF-07 + Legal; severe allegations (e.g., assault) → law enforcement.
workflows.auditRequirements: Confidential case file retained per statutes (EEOC charge = extended retention).

workflows.title: WORKPLACE INJURY / WORKERS' COMP / OSHA REPORTING
workflows.outputs: Incident file; WC claim; OSHA reports; investigation; CAP.
workflows.sla: Cal/OSHA serious injury = 8h; DWC-1 = 1 day; 5020 = 5 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Fatality → Cal/OSHA + federal + law enforcement; executive & Board immediately.
workflows.auditRequirements: OSHA 300/300A retained 5 years; WC records per statute.

workflows.title: SEPARATION (VOLUNTARY / INVOLUNTARY) & EXIT
workflows.outputs: Separation file complete; access terminated; final pay issued.
workflows.sla: Final pay per state; access termination effective separation date; COBRA per DOL.
workflows.escalationLogic: Late final pay → CA Labor Code waiting-time penalties; access left active → IT incident risk.
workflows.auditRequirements: Personnel file retained per law; access-termination evidence.

workflows.title: MONTHLY OIG/SAM RE-SCREENING
workflows.outputs: Monthly screening log; investigation files; suspensions.
workflows.sla: Monthly screening; hits investigated within 24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: Confirmed exclusion → immediate suspension + FN-WF-08 overpayment return pathway.
workflows.auditRequirements: Monthly screening evidence retained 10 years.

workflows.title: INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR / 1099 CLASSIFICATION
workflows.outputs: Classification memo, contract, W-9, annual review.
workflows.sla: Before engagement; annual review.
workflows.escalationLogic: Misclassification suspicion → Legal + CFO; DIR/IRS exposure remediation.
workflows.auditRequirements: Classification memos; contracts; annual reviews retained.

workflows.title: WAGE & HOUR COMPLIANCE (TIMEKEEPING / MEAL-REST)
workflows.outputs: Timekeeping records; itemized wage statements; complaint files.
workflows.sla: Per pay cycle; complaint response ≤10 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Pattern of missed meal/rest → Premium pay + CAP; class-action risk → Legal.
workflows.auditRequirements: Timekeeping retained 3+ years; payroll records 4+ years.

workflows.title: USER ACCESS REVIEW AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Access Review Report; orphan-account log with disable evidence; manager attestation pack.
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Orphan disable: same day. Termination deprovision: ≤24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: Termination not deprovisioned in 24h → CAP via CO-WF-04 + HR-WF-08 escalation. Repeat findings → IT-WF-22 HIPAA monitoring escalation. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: user lists, reconciliation evidence, attestations, disable evidence, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years (HIPAA). Cross-referenced to IT-WF-02, IT-WF-03, IT-WF-04, HR-WF-08, HR-WF-15, IT-WF-22, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: HIPAA SECURITY MONITORING AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly HIPAA Security Monitoring Report; control-test evidence; remediation queue.
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Control failure remediation per HIPAA risk tier.
workflows.escalationLogic: Control failure → IT-WF-09 incident if exploited; CO-WF-10 breach assessment. Material gap → EN-WF-12 enterprise risk + Governing Body via GV-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: SRA snapshot, control-test evidence, remediation status, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years (HIPAA). Cross-referenced to IT-WF-01, IT-WF-05, IT-WF-07, IT-WF-08, IT-WF-09, CO-WF-09, CO-WF-10, EN-WF-12, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: PHI ACCESS MONITORING AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Monthly PHI Access Report; anomaly triage register; breach decisions; discipline actions.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Anomaly triage ≤5 business days. Breach assessment per CO-WF-10 SLA.
workflows.escalationLogic: Confirmed unauthorized access → CO-WF-10 breach + HR-WF-09 + HHS reporting per § 164.408. Pattern → IT-WF-22 + EN-WF-12. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Append-only access logs retained ≥6 years (HIPAA). Per-cycle: log hash, anomaly list, triage evidence, breach decisions, sign-off. Cross-referenced to IT-WF-06, IT-WF-21, IT-WF-22, CO-WF-10, HR-WF-08, HR-WF-09, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: AUDIT LOG REVIEW AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Monthly Audit Log Review Report; per-system status; restore-test evidence; CAP register.
workflows.sla: Monthly. CAPs within 5 business days; logging-disabled gap = same-day fix.
workflows.escalationLogic: Logging disabled → IT-WF-09 incident (control failure) + IT-WF-22 risk update. Repeat → EN-WF-12 + Governing Body via GV-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: inventory, configuration evidence, restore tests, CAPs, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to IT-WF-01, IT-WF-06, IT-WF-09, IT-WF-22, IT-WF-23, EN-WF-12, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: SYSTEM SECURITY AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly System Security Audit Report; control posture scorecard; restore-test evidence; remediation queue.
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Critical vulnerability SLA per IT-WF-08; backup test fail = same-day escalation.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material gap → IT-WF-22 + EN-WF-12 + Governing Body via GV-WF-01. Active threat → IT-WF-09 incident response. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: scan data, patch evidence, restore evidence, incident scoring, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to IT-WF-08, IT-WF-09, IT-WF-10, IT-WF-11, IT-WF-22, EN-WF-12, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: ANNUAL SECURITY RISK ANALYSIS (SRA)
primaryRoles: Security Officer (may coincide with Privacy Officer)
workflows.outputs: Completed SRA; remediation register; Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005) recording approval.
workflows.sla: Annual SRA; remediation per risk priority.
workflows.escalationLogic: Critical risk (e.g., unencrypted ePHI) → emergency remediation within 30 days; Administrator + Board notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: SRA & remediation register retained 6 years (HIPAA). Surveyors verify: SRA date current, methodology, remediation evidence.

workflows.title: USER ACCESS PROVISIONING
workflows.outputs: Access request; provisioning record; AUP acknowledgment; MFA evidence.
workflows.sla: Before start date / role effective date.
workflows.escalationLogic: Requests exceeding role matrix → Security Officer review + documented exception.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-user provisioning record; AUP; role matrix history.

workflows.title: USER ACCESS TERMINATION
workflows.outputs: Termination checklist; disabled account evidence; reconciliation.
workflows.sla: Separation date; involuntary same day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Active account found post-separation → immediate Security Officer incident review; Privacy/security incident assessment (IT-WF-09).
workflows.auditRequirements: Checklist per separation; quarterly reconciliation reports.

workflows.title: QUARTERLY ACCESS REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Review; attestations; change tickets; summary.
workflows.sla: Quarterly; changes ≤10 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unapproved or excess privileges → immediate revocation; potential incident.
workflows.auditRequirements: Review artifacts retained 6 years.

workflows.title: PASSWORD / MFA MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Policy enforcement evidence; MFA enrollment list; attestations; reset records.
workflows.sla: Enrollment within 30 days; annual attestation.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-enrollment after 30 days → access suspension until compliant.
workflows.auditRequirements: Policy config snapshots; MFA coverage reports.

workflows.title: AUDIT LOGGING & MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Logging inventory; alert rules; monthly review report; incidents.
workflows.sla: Monthly review; log retention 6 years.
workflows.escalationLogic: High-severity alert → IT-WF-09 within minutes; Security Officer + Administrator notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: Review evidence, alert configs, retention proof.

workflows.title: BACKUP, DATA RESTORATION & TEST
workflows.outputs: Backup logs; restore test report; remediation.
workflows.sla: Continuous backups; annual restore test.
workflows.escalationLogic: Failed restore → Security Officer + Admin + Governing Body; CAP and re-test.
workflows.auditRequirements: Backup logs; encryption evidence; restore-test reports.

workflows.title: DISASTER RECOVERY & BUSINESS CONTINUITY
workflows.outputs: BIA, DR/BC plan, exercise report, AAR.
workflows.sla: Annual exercise; plan update annual.
workflows.escalationLogic: Actual DR event → IT-WF-09 + RM-WF-02; leadership activation within 1 hour.
workflows.auditRequirements: Plans, exercise records, AARs retained 6 years.

workflows.title: IT SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE
workflows.outputs: Incident ticket, forensics, CAP, breach risk assessment (if applicable), Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005) and Compliance Committee Meeting Minutes (CO-FM-024) evidencing escalation/acceptance.
workflows.sla: S1 container ≤1h; forensics ≤30d; HIPAA breach notifications 60d (≥500 individuals: OCR + media immediately); CMIA 15 business days for clearinghouse medical info breaches.
workflows.escalationLogic: Confirmed PHI breach → CO-WF-10; ransomware with exfiltration → Legal + Exec + external counsel + law enforcement evaluation.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full incident file 6+ years; OCR retains enforcement authority.

workflows.title: DEVICE & ENDPOINT MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Device records; encryption evidence; wipes; sanitization.
workflows.sla: Wipe lost/stolen ≤1h; retire with sanitization before disposal.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unencrypted lost device → presumed breach; CO-WF-10 triggers.
workflows.auditRequirements: Encryption coverage report; lost-device IR tickets.

workflows.title: MOBILE DEVICE / BYOD MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Enrollment evidence; BYOD agreements; wipes.
workflows.sla: Wipe ≤1h; separation unenroll same day.
workflows.escalationLogic: MDM bypass detected → incident; possible disciplinary.
workflows.auditRequirements: MDM inventory; agreements; wipe logs.

workflows.title: REMOVABLE MEDIA / USB RESTRICTIONS
workflows.outputs: DLP evidence; exception tracking; sanitization.
workflows.sla: Exception use time-boxed; sanitize same day post-use.
workflows.escalationLogic: DLP bypass attempts → incident + user HR action.
workflows.auditRequirements: Exception logs; DLP config.

workflows.title: PATCH & VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Scan reports; patch evidence; exception register.
workflows.sla: Critical ≤7d; High ≤30d; Med ≤60d; Low ≤90d.
workflows.escalationLogic: Critical unpatched at SLA → Security Officer + Admin emergency change.
workflows.auditRequirements: Scan records; patch evidence; exception rationale.

workflows.title: CHANGE MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Change request, approvals, test evidence, PIR.
workflows.sla: Per CAB cadence; emergency retro ≤5 days.
