workflows.escalationLogic: Failed change causing outage → IT-WF-09 incident + CAB retrospective.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-change record; CAB minutes; PIRs.

workflows.title: VENDOR / CLOUD SAAS SECURITY REVIEW & BAA
workflows.outputs: Vendor security file; BAA; annual review.
workflows.sla: Pre-contract; annual re-review.
workflows.escalationLogic: Failed security posture → reject vendor or compensating controls + executive acceptance.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-vendor security file; BAA inventory current.

workflows.title: EMAIL SECURITY (PHISHING, ENCRYPTION, DLP)
workflows.outputs: Config register; simulation reports; incident records.
workflows.sla: Quarterly simulations; real-time incident response.
workflows.escalationLogic: BEC confirmed → full IR activation; wire-fraud assessment by Finance (FN-WF).
workflows.auditRequirements: Config snapshots; simulation results; training records.

workflows.title: DATA / MEDIA DISPOSAL & SANITIZATION
workflows.outputs: Sanitization record; destruction cert; inventory update.
workflows.sla: Before disposal.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missing certificate / unsanitized device found → IT-WF-09 + CO-WF-10.
workflows.auditRequirements: Sanitization & destruction records retained 6 years.

workflows.title: REMOTE ACCESS / VPN
workflows.outputs: Access records; session logs; revocations.
workflows.sla: Revocation aligned with HR-WF-14.
workflows.escalationLogic: Suspicious session → IT-WF-09.
workflows.auditRequirements: Session logs; MFA coverage; revocation evidence.

workflows.title: FACILITY PHYSICAL ACCESS CONTROLS
workflows.outputs: Badge log; visitor log; reviews.
workflows.sla: Same-day revocation; quarterly review.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unauthorized physical access → IT-WF-09 + Facility + Police if warranted.
workflows.auditRequirements: Badge + visitor logs retained 6 years.

workflows.title: DATA SUBJECT RIGHTS (CMIA / CCPA ACCESS, DELETE, CORRECT)
workflows.outputs: Request file; data provided/actions taken.
workflows.sla: HIPAA 30d (+30); CCPA 45d (+45).
workflows.escalationLogic: Denial path → appeal process; regulator inquiry → Legal.
workflows.auditRequirements: Full request file retained 6 years (HIPAA) / per CCPA.

workflows.title: BRANCH REGISTRATION & QUARTERLY OPERATIONS REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Branch register current, quarterly ops review, Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005) recording Board briefing/acceptance.
workflows.sla: Quarterly; CMS/State notice prior to opening or closing.
workflows.escalationLogic: Branch-level performance outlier → CAP within 30 days; systemic risk → Committee / Board.
workflows.auditRequirements: Register, CMS filings, quarterly reports retained 7 years.

workflows.title: FACILITY / BRANCH INSPECTION (QUARTERLY)
workflows.outputs: Inspection reports, corrective action records, re-inspection verifications.
workflows.sla: Quarterly; HIGH ≤24h; MED ≤7 days; LOW ≤30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Unsafe condition → immediate cordon / rectification; Risk Manager + Administrator notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: Reports retained 3+ years; corrective action evidence.

workflows.title: VENDOR LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Vendor file (request, qualifications, contract, BAA, performance, evaluations, termination).
workflows.sla: Qualification 14 days; contract pre-service; annual review; response to CAP ≤30 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: OIG/SAM match: reject; AKS/Stark concern: Legal; performance 2 CAPs: termination review.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-vendor file complete; approved list current; OIG screen evidence.

workflows.title: APPROVED VENDOR LIST MAINTENANCE
workflows.outputs: Current approved list; exception memos.
workflows.sla: Updates ≤7 days; annual recert.
workflows.escalationLogic: Repeated off-list purchases → Administrator + Compliance to investigate.
workflows.auditRequirements: List history & exceptions traceable.

workflows.title: EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT
workflows.outputs: Authorization memo, expedited qualifications, retroactive full vetting.
workflows.sla: Screen before PO; full vet within 30 days post-emergency.
workflows.escalationLogic: OIG/SAM match during emergency: immediate alternative sought.
workflows.auditRequirements: Emergency authorization + post-event vetting complete.

workflows.title: INCOMING / OUTGOING MAIL & FAX MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Logs; confirmations; incident reports (if applicable).
workflows.sla: Same-day logging; time-sensitive routing ≤1 business day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Mis-sent PHI → Compliance Officer within 4h; CO-WF-10 activated.
workflows.auditRequirements: Daily logs; fax cover sheet compliance sample.

workflows.title: PATIENT INTAKE ADMINISTRATION
workflows.outputs: Complete admission packet, insurance verification evidence, scheduling.
workflows.sla: Same-day intake; pre-SOC packet.
workflows.escalationLogic: Insurance denial / coverage issue → Administrator/Finance; patient financial counseling.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-admission complete admin file.

workflows.title: NON-ADMIT / REFERRAL REJECTION MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Non-admit log with categories; referral-back communications.
workflows.sla: Same-day log; 24h communication.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-admit rate >10% Q/Q → Clinical Manager + Administrator review.
workflows.auditRequirements: Log with reasons; analytics retained.

workflows.title: VEHICLE MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Driver records, inspection logs, accident reports, reimbursement records.
workflows.sla: Annual verification; monthly inspection; immediate accident reporting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Accident with injury → HR-WF / RM-WF-10; OSHA reporting if applicable.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-driver file; inspection logs; incident investigations.

workflows.title: PATIENT PROPERTY HANDLING
workflows.outputs: Inventory with signatures at custody and return; loss/incident records.
workflows.sla: Same-day inventory and return.
workflows.escalationLogic: Property loss → Legal + insurance within 24h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Inventory records retained per policy.

workflows.title: LANGUAGE ACCESS / INTERPRETER SERVICES
workflows.outputs: Usage log, translated document evidence.
workflows.sla: Before SOC and at each encounter requiring language access.
workflows.escalationLogic: Interpreter unavailable → Clinical Manager / Administrator; alternative (video, phone) within 24h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Usage log; documents in preferred language evidence.

workflows.title: SCHEDULING & CONFLICT RESOLUTION
workflows.outputs: Schedules; conflict log; LUPA monitoring.
workflows.sla: Weekly schedule ≥24h before execution; same-day conflict resolution.
workflows.escalationLogic: Chronic understaffing → Administrator + Clinical Manager; consider contractor engagement (HR-WF).
workflows.auditRequirements: Schedule history; conflict resolutions; missed visit linkage (CL-WF-20).

workflows.title: AFTER-HOURS ON-CALL OPERATIONS
workflows.outputs: On-call activity log; chart entries; handoffs.
workflows.sla: Call response within defined window (e.g., 15 minutes); chart entry within 24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: Emergency → 911; notify family, physician; on-call supervisor engaged; next-day clinical review.
workflows.auditRequirements: On-call log complete; chart linkage.

workflows.title: KPI DATA AGGREGATION
workflows.outputs: Enterprise KPI Dataset (immutable snapshot); reconciliation evidence; lineage manifest.
workflows.sla: Monthly by 5th business day; QA-WF-02 publication depends on it.
workflows.escalationLogic: Source-system gap → IT-WF-14 change-mgmt request. Reconciliation failure → QA-WF-16 (data validation) hold. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: extract hashes, reconciliation evidence, dataset hash, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-02, QA-WF-03, QA-WF-16.

workflows.title: PERFORMANCE INDICATOR TRACKING
workflows.outputs: Indicator scorecard; trend charts; PIP candidate memo.
workflows.sla: Monthly by 9th business day.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material regression → QA-WF-04 PIP. Star-rating impact → QA-WF-09. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: scorecard, trend charts, PIP triggers, sign-offs. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-13, QA-WF-04, QA-WF-09, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: TREND ANALYSIS
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Trend Analysis Memo; control charts; pattern register.
workflows.sla: Quarterly, ≥5 business days before QA-WF-03 meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Special-cause regression → QA-WF-04 PIP candidate. Cross-domain pattern → EN-WF-12 enterprise risk. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: panel hash, charts, pattern register, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-13, QA-WF-14, QA-WF-04, QA-WF-03, EN-WF-12.

workflows.title: QAPI DATA VALIDATION
approvalRoles: IT Director for material data issues
workflows.outputs: Per-dataset validation log; quarterly QAPI Data Validation Report; defect register.
workflows.sla: Continuous; quarterly report ≥5 business days before QA-WF-03 meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Validation hold blocks QA-WF-02 publication and QA-WF-03 closure until resolved. Source-system defect → IT-WF-14 change request. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-dataset log: schema check, sample trace evidence, reconciliation evidence, holds, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-13, QA-WF-02, QA-WF-03, IT-WF-14.

workflows.title: PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT PLAN MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Quarterly PIP Monitoring Report; per-PIP scorecard; decision register.
workflows.sla: Quarterly, before QA-WF-03 meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: PIP remeasurement failure → revise intervention or escalate to mandatory new PIP. Sustained PIP failure → Governing Body escalation via GV-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: PIP register, scorecards, decisions, remeasurement evidence, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-04, QA-WF-13, QA-WF-15, GV-WF-01, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: POLICY EFFECTIVENESS MONITORING
approvalRoles: Governing Body for material policy revisions
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Policy Effectiveness Report; policy-level defect map; revision queue.
workflows.sla: Quarterly, before QA-WF-03 meeting.
workflows.escalationLogic: Sustained policy ineffectiveness → mandatory revision via EN-WF-01. Cross-domain policy gap → EN-WF-12 enterprise risk register. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: defect aggregate, policy map, revision tickets, sign-offs. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to ALL audit workflows, EN-WF-01, GV-WF-01, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: QAPI PROGRAM CHARTER & ANNUAL REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Approved QAPI charter (versioned), Committee minutes, Board minutes, training records.
workflows.sla: Annual approval within 30 days of FY start.
workflows.escalationLogic: Approval delay >30 days: interim charter continues under prior version + temporary amendment; Administrator + Chair notified.
workflows.auditRequirements: Charter (current version), Board approval, committee training, measure list traceable to data sources.

workflows.title: MONTHLY QUALITY INDICATOR DASHBOARD PRODUCTION
workflows.outputs: Monthly dashboard archived, variance commentary, RCA queue.
workflows.sla: Dashboard released by day 15 of each month.
workflows.escalationLogic: Data integrity issue → IT + Clinical Manager within 48h; substantial spike in adverse indicator → ad-hoc Committee call within 7 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: 12 months of dashboards available; data lineage traceable; source system reconciliations.

workflows.title: QUARTERLY QAPI COMMITTEE REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Minutes, action log, quarterly report for Governing Body.
workflows.sla: Quarterly (every 90 days max); minutes ≤14 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Sentinel event or Immediate Jeopardy signal → emergency Committee + Administrator + Governing Body Chair within 24–72 hours. Any pre-input audit not complete → meeting deferred or partial-scope meeting with documented gap and CAP. Material findings escalate to GV-WF-01 and EN-WF-12. Cross-domain pattern triggers QA-WF-04 PIP via QA-WF-17 monitoring. Aggregated audit results: CL-WF-26..37, CO-WF-23..30, QA-WF-13..18, HR-WF-18..21, RM-WF-16..20, IT-WF-21..25.
workflows.auditRequirements: 4 quarters of minutes; Board-review evidence; action closure traceable. Each cycle packet must include the pre-input completeness log proving every required audit (CL-WF-26..37, CO-WF-23..30, QA-WF-13..18, HR-WF-18..21, RM-WF-16..20, IT-WF-21..25) was complete and signed before the meeting. Cross-referenced to GV-WF-01, EN-WF-12, QA-WF-04, QA-WF-17.

workflows.title: ANNUAL PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (PIP) LIFECYCLE
workflows.outputs: PIP charter, RCA, intervention plan, 30/60/90 day measurements, closure/sustainment packet, Board minutes.
workflows.sla:
- At least one PIP active each calendar year (CoP).
- Charter ≤30 days of kickoff; intervention ≤30 days of RCA; remeasurement per plan.
workflows.escalationLogic: No target progress after two measurement cycles → Committee revises strategy; re-scope if needed. Sustainment failure post-closure → reopen PIP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Data-linked charter, RCA, interventions with named owners, measurement data, Board review, sustainment evidence all retained ≥7 years.

workflows.title: ADVERSE EVENT REPORTING, RCA & CORRECTIVE ACTION
workflows.outputs: Incident file, RCA, CAP, effectiveness measurement, communication log, Board minutes.
workflows.sla: Initial report 24h; RCA ≤30 days; effectiveness check ≥90 days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Sentinel event: emergency QAPI + executive session + mandatory reporting assessment (state, accreditor, CMS) within 24h. Pattern of events: new PIP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-event file with all steps; retention 10 years (or statute of limitations, whichever longer).

workflows.title: INFECTION CONTROL SURVEILLANCE (QAPI-INTEGRATED)
workflows.outputs: Line list, surveillance trend, investigation notes, reportable disease evidence, PIP (if triggered).
workflows.sla: Continuous surveillance; public health reporting per statute; trend review monthly; outbreak protocol activation immediate.
workflows.escalationLogic: Outbreak → Administrator + Governing Body Chair + Public Health + Compliance Officer within 24h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Line list current; investigation evidence; reportable disease confirmations; trends reported to Board.

workflows.title: LUPA PREVENTION & VISIT UTILIZATION MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Weekly reports, monthly trend, financial impact summary, missed visit documentation.
workflows.sla: Weekly reporting; daily missed visit documentation.
workflows.escalationLogic: Systematic underutilization → QAPI PIP; overutilization pattern → compliance investigation.
workflows.auditRequirements: Weekly reports, missed visit logs, financial impact evidence, investigation links.

workflows.title: HHCAHPS MONITORING & RESPONSE
workflows.outputs: PER confirmation (if exempt), vendor records (if participating), monthly submission evidence, PIP (if triggered).
workflows.sla: PER by March 31; vendor monthly submissions; preview response per CMS.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed PER deadline → HH QRP APU reduction → escalate to Administrator + Governing Body; documented as compliance deficiency.
workflows.auditRequirements: PER confirmation or vendor submission evidence for each reporting period; CMS correspondence.

workflows.title: STAR RATING & PUBLIC REPORT MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Preview archive, corrections submitted, benchmarking report, improvement plan, PIP (if applicable).
workflows.sla: Corrections within CMS data correction window; action plan within 30 days of preview release.
workflows.escalationLogic: Rating drop of ≥ ½ star → priority action; Governing Body briefed at next meeting.
workflows.auditRequirements: Archived preview reports; data correction submissions; action plans; minutes.

workflows.title: QAPI SELF-ASSESSMENT (ANNUAL)
workflows.outputs: Completed checklist, gap log, updated charter.
workflows.sla: Annual.
workflows.escalationLogic: Material gaps → CAP within 30 days; Board-level issues escalated.
workflows.auditRequirements: Completed checklist, evidence of Committee and Board review.

workflows.title: POLICY EFFECTIVENESS MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Effectiveness worksheets, decisions log.
workflows.sla: 30/60/90 day measurement windows.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-sustained improvement → reopen PIP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Worksheets per closed CAP/PIP; decisions recorded.

workflows.title: PATIENT SAFETY EVENT COMMUNICATION
workflows.outputs: Disclosure notes, communication log, internal memo, Board minutes.
workflows.sla: Disclosure within 72h of determination; Board notification at next meeting (emergency if sentinel).
workflows.escalationLogic: Allegations of negligence/harm → Legal engaged immediately; Risk Manager coordinates with insurance carrier.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-event communication log with dates, attendees, content; Board minute evidence for sentinel.

workflows.title: INCIDENT TREND ANALYSIS
workflows.outputs: Monthly Incident Trend Report; cluster register; rate trend; RCA queue.
workflows.sla: Monthly. Sentinel event RCA initiated within 24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: Sentinel / cluster → QA-WF-05 RCA + EN-WF-12 enterprise risk register update. Repeat cluster → QA-WF-04 PIP. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Append-only incident log retained ≥6 years. Per-cycle: dataset hash, categorization, rate calc, RCA queue, sign-off. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-05, RM-WF-10, HR-WF-13, CO-WF-03, IT-WF-25, EN-WF-12, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: SAFETY MONITORING
workflows.outputs: Monthly Safety Audit Report; observation scorecard; CAP register.
workflows.sla: Monthly. CAPs ≤5 business days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Cluster events → RM-WF-16. Cal/OSHA exposure → RM-WF-08 update. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: inspection data, observation scoring, CAPs, sign-off. Retention ≥5 years (Cal/OSHA). Cross-referenced to RM-WF-08, RM-WF-09, CL-WF-14, OP-WF-09, RM-WF-16, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: ENVIRONMENTAL RISK REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Environmental Risk Review; updated risk register entries; mitigation CAPs.
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Mitigations within risk-tier SLA.
workflows.escalationLogic: High-tier risk → RM-WF-01 + EN-WF-12 enterprise risk consolidation; Governing Body via GV-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: dataset hashes, risk reassessment, CAPs, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to RM-WF-01, RM-WF-02, OP-WF-02, EN-WF-12, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS READINESS AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly EP Readiness Report; gap register; readiness scorecard; drill evidence.
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Gap closure within next quarter or sooner if material.
workflows.escalationLogic: Readiness gap → CAP and EN-WF-12 update. Material gap → Governing Body via GV-WF-01. Findings feed QA-WF-03.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: verification evidence, drill results, gap register, sign-off. Retention ≥6 years. Cross-referenced to RM-WF-03, RM-WF-04, RM-WF-05, RM-WF-06, RM-WF-07, EN-WF-12, GV-WF-01, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: INCIDENT RESPONSE COMPLIANCE AUDIT
workflows.outputs: Quarterly Incident Response Audit Report; per-incident scorecard; mandatory-report compliance register; CAP queue.
workflows.sla: Quarterly. Missed external report → escalate same day; remediate within 5 business days.
workflows.escalationLogic: Missed mandatory report → immediate filing + CO-WF-16 self-disclosure consideration. Pattern → CAP via CO-WF-04. Findings feed QA-WF-03 and CO-WF-22.
workflows.auditRequirements: Per-cycle log: incident roster, scoring, mandatory-report evidence, CAPs, sign-off. Retention ≥10 years. Cross-referenced to QA-WF-05, CL-WF-22, CL-WF-23, CO-WF-10, HR-WF-13, IT-WF-09, CO-WF-16, CO-WF-30, QA-WF-03.

workflows.title: ENTERPRISE RISK REGISTER & QUARTERLY RISK REVIEW
workflows.outputs: Current risk register, quarterly report to Board, annual reassessment.
workflows.sla: Quarterly updates; annual reassessment.
workflows.escalationLogic: Any risk scored HIGH with no mitigation → immediate escalation to Administrator + Governing Body Chair.
workflows.auditRequirements: Register versions; quarterly **RM-FM-017 Risk Committee Meeting Minutes** and **GV-FM-005 Governing Body Meeting Minutes** recording acceptance; annual reassessment on file.

workflows.title: ANNUAL HAZARD VULNERABILITY ANALYSIS (HVA)
workflows.outputs: Completed HVA, risk register update, EP plan change log.
workflows.sla: Annual HVA; biennial integration with EP program review (§ 484.102(a)).
workflows.escalationLogic: Newly identified HIGH hazard → EP plan update within 60 days + training within 180 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Scored HVA on file; version history; linkage to EP plan and training.

workflows.title: BIENNIAL EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS PROGRAM REVIEW/UPDATE
workflows.outputs: Approved EP plan (versioned), updated communication plan, revised policies, training plan.
workflows.sla: Biennial (§ 484.102); exercise remains annual (RM-WF-05).
workflows.escalationLogic: Significant update ("significant update = yes") triggers mandatory training within 90 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Version history; Board approval; change log.

workflows.title: BIENNIAL EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS STAFF TRAINING
workflows.outputs: Rosters, post-tests, completion certificates.
workflows.sla: Biennial; 90 days post-significant-update; 30 days for new hires.
workflows.escalationLogic: Non-completion > 30 days past due → HR discipline; continued → access restriction.
workflows.auditRequirements: Rosters, post-test evidence, attestations retained per cycle.

workflows.title: ANNUAL EMERGENCY EXERCISE
workflows.outputs: Exercise documentation, attendance, AAR/IP, corrective actions, plan updates.
workflows.sla: Annual; AAR ≤14 days; corrective actions per AAR dates (typically ≤60 days).
workflows.escalationLogic: Material failure in exercise → emergency plan review; EP Coord + Administrator convene within 14 days.
workflows.auditRequirements: Exercise plan, attendance, AAR, corrective actions, plan change evidence. Retain cycle evidence 5+ years.

workflows.title: PANDEMIC / INFECTIOUS-DISEASE SURGE READINESS
workflows.outputs: Readiness checklist completion, inventory evidence, activation records.
workflows.sla: Annual check; same-day activation on trigger.
workflows.escalationLogic: PPE par below 14 days → urgent procurement + Administrator briefed.
workflows.auditRequirements: Readiness checklist, inventory evidence, activation file (if activated).

workflows.title: PATIENT PRIORITY CLASSIFICATION & EMERGENCY ACTIVATION
workflows.outputs: Per-patient priority classification in chart; activation logs; after-action links.
workflows.sla: Classification at SOC and on significant change; activation response per triage levels (life-support contact within hours).
workflows.escalationLogic: Unable to reach high-priority patient within defined window → Administrator + EP Coord + emergency services notification.
workflows.auditRequirements: Priority classification visible in each active chart; activation event files.

workflows.title: CAL/OSHA IIPP MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: IIPP doc (current), hazard assessments, corrections, injury investigations, training rosters, committee minutes.
workflows.sla: Quarterly assessments; annual review; hazard correction per priority; investigation within 24h.
workflows.escalationLogic: Serious injury → Cal/OSHA reporting (within 8 hours of serious injury/illness/death per CA DIR); immediate Administrator notification.
workflows.auditRequirements: Current IIPP, hazard assessments, corrections, training records, investigation files, committee minutes retained 3+ years (5+ for some elements).

workflows.title: WORKPLACE VIOLENCE PREVENTION (SB 553)
workflows.outputs: WVPP (current), incident log (5-year retention), investigation files, training rosters, psych support referrals, corrective actions.
workflows.sla: Incident report within 24h; investigation within 14 days; retention 5 years (SB 553).
workflows.escalationLogic: Serious threat / actual violence → law enforcement; Administrator notified within 4 hours; protective measures (reassignment, safety plan) immediate.
workflows.auditRequirements: WVPP, training rosters, violent incident log, investigation files, corrective action records — 5 years.

workflows.title: WORKPLACE INJURY & OSHA RECORDKEEPING
workflows.outputs: OSHA 300 log (current), 300A posted annually, investigation files, BBP records.
workflows.sla: 300 log within 7 days; 300A posting Feb 1–Apr 30; electronic submission by March 2.
workflows.escalationLogic: Severe injury / hospitalization / amputation → OSHA report per § 1904.39 (8 hours for fatality; 24 hours for in-patient hospitalization, amputation, loss of eye).
workflows.auditRequirements: OSHA logs retained 5 years; 300A archival; investigation evidence; BBP sharps log.

workflows.title: HAZARDOUS MATERIALS & SPILL MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Current SDS, training rosters, spill reports, disposal manifests.
workflows.sla: Annual inventory; spill response immediate; reportable spill per statute.
workflows.escalationLogic: Reportable spill → state agency; Administrator notified within 4h.
workflows.auditRequirements: Inventory, training rosters, disposal manifests retained 3 years minimum.

workflows.title: EQUIPMENT RECALL & SAFETY NOTIFICATION
workflows.outputs: Recall log, affected list, patient contact evidence, MDR (if applicable), disposal manifests.
workflows.sla: Affected identification ≤72h; patient contact per recall urgency; MDR per 21 CFR § 803.
workflows.escalationLogic: Class I recall → Administrator + Clinical Mgr within 4h; Governing Body informed.
workflows.auditRequirements: Recall log, patient contact evidence, MDR filings retained per policy.

workflows.title: HIGH-RISK MEDICATION DOUBLE-CHECK
workflows.outputs: Double-check log, MAR entries, any adverse event files.
workflows.sla: Before each administration/teach for high-alert meds.
workflows.escalationLogic: Error or near-miss → QA-WF-05 RCA within 30 days; pattern → PIP.
workflows.auditRequirements: Double-check logs linked to MAR/chart; audit sample reviewed quarterly.

workflows.title: LITIGATION & CLAIMS MANAGEMENT
workflows.outputs: Claims register, legal holds, insurance notifications, investigation files, settlement/judgment records.
workflows.sla: Insurance notice per policy (often immediate); internal investigation per counsel.
workflows.escalationLogic: Criminal matter → criminal counsel engaged; Chair + Compliance Officer notified immediately.
workflows.auditRequirements: Claims register, hold register, insurance notices, legal file references. Retain per counsel guidance (often 10+ years).

workflows.title: ANNUAL ENTERPRISE RISK REASSESSMENT
workflows.outputs: Annual reassessment, updated register, mitigation plan, **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** recording approval of risk appetite and top risks.
workflows.sla: Annual; updates within 30 days of Board.
workflows.escalationLogic: New HIGH risk with no mitigation → same-day Administrator; emergency Governing Body session if warranted.
workflows.auditRequirements: Annual report, updated register, **Governing Body Meeting Minutes (GV-FM-005)** evidencing approval.
